operations.before: Track each totem's duration and the shared concentration burden. operations.replacement: **Totem capacity is 1, becoming 2 at Shaman 13.** An ordinary new Totem placed at capacity replaces one chosen active Totem; an optional Echo requires its own free capacity and does not evict a Totem. archivedTD13Replacement: KEEP your own destroyed device, one minute after combat, once per short rest, consume its qualifying usable debris and return at most1RP actually paid to **deploy that same device**. Enemy cause is **not required** for Efficient Recycling. Crafting GP, ingredients, dawn charges, service packs, encoding, field repairs, Dissonance routing and later Overcharge RP are not deployment RP. These43 crafted devices have no innate RP deployment cost, so they create **zero refundable deployment RP** through this card. A quoted recipe value does not create paid RP; retain the actual deployment transaction and its paid amount. Deliberate sacrifice, copied objects, already-consumed debris, prohibited resource-generation branches and applicable no-own-destruction-chain restrictions remain excluded. Use only the original instance's qualifying single-consumer material; no repeated salvage or reconstructed-instance refresh. Do not transfer this ruling to Scrap Salvage, Scrap Reaper, Volatile Components or another feature with its own hostile-cause or enemy-hit predicate. No unspecified material salvage percentage is added by the class's legacy name.
